[[Count/Legends|Count]] '''Phennir''' was a well-known [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[Valahari sector/Legends|Valahari Provinces]]. He had a stepson named [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], who was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] pilot in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]]. Turr also had a brother [[Cartha|"Chaser" Cartha]] who flew in the [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|61st squadron]].<ref name="TFU">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="TEGTWAC" />
